interface.signature: def strWithout3a3b(A: int, B: int) -> str

preconditions.description: A must be between 0 and 100 inclusive.
B must be between 0 and 100 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The length of the returned string must be equal to A + B.
The returned string must contain exactly A 'a' letters.
The returned string must contain exactly B 'b' letters.
The substring 'aaa' must not occur in the returned string.
The substring 'bbb' must not occur in the returned string.
